تستحملوا (form X)
# تَسْتَحْمِلُوا (tastaḥmilū) /tas.taħ.mi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْمَلَ (istaḥmala)
# تُسْتَحْمَلُوا (tustaḥmalū) /tus.taħ.ma.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْمَلَ (istaḥmala)
